subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these six upstream action revisions for workflows that scan repository content, upload security reports, and authenticate to container registries?
rationale: The patch is mechanically compatible, but accepting executable third-party revisions in credentialed and security-reporting workflows is a trust-boundary decision rather than a contributor-side code repair.

options.title: Approve the reviewed action revisions
options.body: Accept the six immutable upstream pins after a workflow-security owner confirms the upstream release changes and the refreshed branch checks pass.

options.title: Hold for a newer Dependabot refresh
options.body: Pause this PR until Dependabot can rebase successfully and regenerate the update against the current workflow baseline.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed action revisions
recommendation.body: Accept the six immutable upstream pins after a workflow-security owner confirms the upstream release changes and the refreshed branch checks pass.
